subject: No graphs displaid in deployed Shiny app

messages.author: 804215543fb072d8
messages.subject: No graphs displaid in deployed Shiny app
parts:
Dear all,

first message in this mailing list, yeah (?) !

So, i'm building an app with Shiny. The basic idea is to perform PCA Analysis with FactomineR on data that the user can upload (excel sheet), and then to display the results in several graphs :

p<-res.hcpc<-HCPC(res ,nb.clust=-1,consol=FALSE,min=3,max=10,graph=TRUE)
    plot(p, choice = "2D.map")

On local, everything works well, I can upload the data and display the graphs correctly. The problem comes when I deploy the app. No error :

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
[...]
Application successfully deployed

But when I try to do exactly the same thing on the web, no graphs are shown (but everything else seems to be working fine).

Any idea where that could come from ?


Cheers,

Léolo
